title: CC 400 air purifier
description: Built-in CC 400 air purifier with interchangeable filters — reduces particles, odours and volatile organic compounds.
paragraphs: CC 400 is a built-in air purifier that can be equipped with different filters according to the need and application. The filters ensure that the CC 400 air purifier effectively reduces harmful particles, odours and other volatile organic compounds commonly found in indoor air in homes, offices, schools, hospitals, sports halls and other public buildings.
benefits: Reduced presence of volatile organic compounds in the air
